verdict.rationale: There is no dataset marketplace in the evidence. MotherDuck does document public shares that anyone with a MotherDuck account in the same cloud region can access (docs-64). A share can be attached by URL and queried alongside your own data, as in the hacker_news share example (docs-24). That gives a mechanism for using third-party data in the platform, but not a curated marketplace. Missing for 10: a discoverable marketplace or catalog of third-party datasets, provider listings or commercial data products, cross-region availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration of enriching data with public shares.
